_comment: LBNL FDD fan-coil unit (FCU) point name -> CAMBER Role mapping. A third BAS naming convention: unlike the cooling-only SDAHU, the FCU has BOTH a cooling and a heating coil plus an OA damper, so the outdoor-air-fraction and simultaneous-heating/cooling detectors both apply. Adding this equipment family is a config file, not a code change. Dataset: LBNL Fault Detection and Diagnostics Datasets (CC-BY). Valves and dampers map to the controller DEMAND columns (*_DM), not the measured positions: CAMBER's rules read these roles as commands (a leak is cooling while the valve is *commanded* closed; economizer drift is OA fraction *at matched damper command*), and a stuck or leaking device's position is precisely what hides the fault. Until 0.82.0 these mapped the positions.
